storm-default.description: Storm with default settings, nature resolving the intervals adversarially, and an absolute precision of 1e-6 like IntervalMDP.jl. --sound is not supported for interval models.

prism-default.description: Prism with default settings and an absolute precision of 1e-6 like IntervalMDP.jl. -intervaliter is not supported for interval models.

intervalmdp-default.description: IntervalMDP.jl with default settings and an absolute precision of 1e-6. It cannot import reachability rewards; those that count steps are solved as expected exit times.
